dimensions.assessment: Affects owners and operators of sawmills and wood-processing facilities in rural areas near eligible federal lands, as well as the Department of Agriculture and Department of the Interior.
dimensions.evidence: eligible entity means an individual or entity that owns or operates a sawmill or other wood-processing facility located in a rural area

dimensions.assessment: Provides financial backing through loan guarantees up to a cumulative maximum of $220,000,000 to help establish, reopen, retrofit, or expand facilities.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may provide a total of not more than $220,000,000 in loan guarantees under the Program.

dimensions.assessment: Limits total federal loan guarantees to $220,000,000, though specific federal administrative costs or appropriations amounts are not detailed.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may provide a total of not more than $220,000,000 in loan guarantees under the Program.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes formal requirements for the Secretaries of Agriculture and the Interior to identify high-priority federal lands and administer a specific loan guarantee program.
dimensions.evidence: To establish requirements under which the Secretary of Agriculture and the Secretary of the Interior shall carry out the Timber Production Expansion Guaranteed Loan Program.

dimensions.assessment: Requires periodic reviews of federal land not less than once every 5 years, with loan guarantees and facility modifications providing ongoing regional effects.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, and not less frequently than once every 5 years thereafter

missing_information: Total federal appropriations or budgetary outlays required to back the loan guarantees
Exact number of sawmills expected to receive loan guarantees
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes a loan guarantee program up to $220,000,000 for rural sawmills and wood-processing facilities located near federal land identified for ecological restoration.

card.label: H.R. 7567
card.summary: The Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026 reauthorizes, modifies, and funds a wide variety of United States Department of Agriculture programs across twelve titles through fiscal year 2031. It adjusts commodity programs, conservation efforts, nutrition assistance like SNAP, agricultural trade, credit and loan limits, rural development, forestry, energy initiatives, horticulture, crop insurance, animal health, and foreign agricultural land ownership reporting.
